notes:
Ask the assistant for something and it can now do it. Any command Corylus has — opening a panel, switching the view, starting a compile — can be asked for in plain words instead of hunted for in a menu. Anything that would change your text still stops and asks you first.

The assistant can also answer questions about the project you have open: how many words you have written, what is in the binder, what a document says, and where a phrase appears. It only reads — it never edits your text.

The licence under a gallery background now reads in your language, in the confirmation window and in My backgrounds.
